auto.purpose: Route bounded work to the best eligible capability/provider under active policy.

assisted.purpose: AI proposes next actions, user selects or edits.

api.purpose: Provider/API-led workflow for bounded external capabilities.

node.purpose: Operate as one local/distributed CGX node using declared device/network capability.

code.purpose: Use code/tests/build tools and temporary Git/local surfaces.

chat-build.purpose: Build or modify from conversational intent via proposed structured deltas.
chat-build.human_gate: before protected mutation unless profile explicitly permits

review.purpose: Read/compare/audit with mutation disabled by default.

publish.purpose: Generate controlled representations from an approved source state/lens.

extension_rule: A work mode cannot lower a context-required extension mode. Any reduction of a mandatory gate requires separate governing authority and a recorded receipt.
assurance_rule: Work mode cannot suppress an applicable assurance method or lower a required VERIFY/SAFETY_CASE/HOLD state. Method applicability and risk acceptance remain separate.
